latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the data-analysis skill.
- Enables understanding, exploring, cleaning, and summarizing datasets with strict focus on data quality and user objectives.
- Provides clear guidelines for data quality assessment, process documentation, and business-oriented result interpretation.
- Includes best practices and constraints to ensure transparency, explainability, and user-driven analysis.
- Offers template formats and real-world examples for analysis reports and processing records.
